claim.claim-text: a user apparatus; and a base station that configures at least one serving cell for wireless communication with the user apparatus, wherein the base station transmits, to the user apparatus with using RRC signaling, information related to at least one beam used in the at least one serving cell.

2. The communication system according to Claim 1, wherein the user apparatus performs measurement on each beam of the at least one serving cell and transmits a result of the measurement to the base station.

3. The communication system according to Claim 1, wherein the base station transmits, to the user apparatus, information related to a beam configured by a secondary cell (SCell) included in the at least one serving cell.

4. The communication system according to Claim 1, wherein the base station transmits, to the user apparatus, MAC control information that includes indication related to activation / deactivation of the at least one beam used in the at least one serving cell.

5. A base station in a communication system comprising: a user apparatus; and the base station that configures at least one serving cell for wireless communication with the user apparatus, wherein the base station transmits, to the user apparatus with using RRC signaling, information related to at least one beam used in the at least one serving cell.
6. A user apparatus in a communication system comprising: the user apparatus;

and a base station that configures at least one serving cell for wireless communication with the user apparatus, wherein the user apparatus receives information transmitted from the base station with using RRC signaling and related to at least one beam used in the at least one serving cell, and performs the wireless communication based on the information.
